blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2–3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000.
Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant .
blocks.zh:
最近的基础模型正在向本土的多模式远景-语言模型(VLMs)发展,使VLMs成为下一代基础模型的核心形式. 然而,由于内存足迹高和内存约束的自递解码,他们的大型语言骨干使得边缘部署困难. 仅重的训练后量化是一个实用的解决方案,但将VLM推向极低比特宽仍然具有挑战性:现有的无旋转方法在2–3比特时出现异常值,而基于旋转的方法则以额外的运行时间管理成本提高精度. 我们提出SPHQuant,一个无旋转的球面重量唯量化框架,用于VLM. SPHQuant不直接在笛卡尔座标中量化重量,而是将每个8D重量矢量分解成坐标标志,半径,以及正单位方向. 这种表示法将超出范围的范围隔离到半径,同时保持方向的界限和统计规律。 基于这种洞察力,SPHQuant将额外的精度分配到半径上,以减轻由外延器引起的精度降解. 它通过角参数化进一步使用紧凑的正向编码本,并对编码本条目进行微调,以保留单位-层约束. 我们还设计了一个硬件友好的GEMV内核,使方向码库足够小,可以进行共享模版的检索,并高效地包装射线位点. 实验显示,SPHQuant与最先进的极低位量化方法的性能相匹配,同时在RTX A6000上将解码吞吐量比QTIP提高30.3%.
守则将在https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant中发布。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent foundation models are moving beyond text-only language models toward unified vision-language foundation models [ 11 , 21 , 1 ] . Rather than treating vision modules as add-ons to text-only LLMs, recent models jointly learn from vision and text tokens during training, making multimodal understanding a native capability. This shift makes VLMs an important model family and creates a growing need for edge deployment. Many VLM applications, such as mobile assistants [ 6 , 7 ] , on-device OCR, document understanding, embodied agents, and real-time visual reasoning, require low latency, privacy preservation, and reduced dependence on network connectivity. However, deploying VLMs on edge devices remains challenging: their billion-scale parameters require large device memory, while memory-bound autoregressive inference limits decode throughput.
blocks.zh: 最近的基础模型正在超越文本语言模型,转向统一的视觉语言基础模型[11, 21, 1]. 近期的模型不是将视觉模块作为仅文本的LLMs的附加内容,而是在培训期间共同学习视觉和文本符号,使多式联运理解成为本土能力。 这种转变使VLMs成为一个重要的模范家族,并造成越来越需要边缘部署. 许多VLM应用程序,如移动助理[6,7],在线设备OCR,文档理解,内含代理,以及实时视觉推理,都需要低潜伏度,隐私保护,并减少对网络连接的依赖. 然而,在边缘设备上部署VLM仍然具有挑战性:它们的十亿级参数需要大型设备内存,而内存绑定的自递性推论限制解码吞吐量.

blocks.en: Quantization has been explored across visual tasks, including image demoiréing [ 5 ] and video super-resolution [ 2 , 29 ] . For VLM deployment, weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) provides a practical way to reduce weight storage and memory traffic during autoregressive decoding. Although 4-bit weight-only quantization has been widely adopted [ 15 ] , pushing VLMs to more aggressive 2 or 3 bit settings remains necessary for fitting larger multimodal models on memory-constrained devices. Existing methods, however, still struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency at such extreme bit-widths. QTIP achieves state-of-the-art 2 bit weight-only quantization with randomized-Hadamard incoherence processing [ 25 ] , but its transforms introduce additional inference operations; ParoQuant reduces rotation overhead through pairwise Givens rotations [ 14 ] , but its accuracy rapidly degrades at 2–3 bits due to the limitations of linear quantization. Preserving outlier weights in FP16 can improve accuracy but requires hardware-unfriendly sparse-dense computation.
blocks.zh: 跨视觉任务探索量化,包括图像降级[5]和视频超分辨率[2,29]. 对于VLM的部署,只重的训练后量化(PTQ)提供了一种实用的方法,在自动回转解码过程中减少重量存储和内存流量. 虽然4位重量唯量化被广泛采用[15],但将VLM推向更具攻击性的2位或3位设置,对于在内存约束设备上安装更大的多式联运模型来说仍然是必要的. 然而,现有方法仍然难以在如此极端的位宽下平衡准确性和效率。 QTIP通过随机化-Hadamard的不一致性处理实现最先进的2位重单量化[25],但其变换引入了额外的推论操作; ParoQuant通过对映式 Givers 旋转[14] 来减少旋转的垂直性,但由于线性化的限制,其精度以2–3位迅速下降. 在FP16中保留外部权重可以提高准确性,但需要硬件不方便的稀疏计算.

blocks.en: This motivates a question: can we handle weight outliers with low overhead under extreme low-bit VLM quantization? We argue that the difficulty is not only caused by the limited bit-width, but also by the coordinate system in which weights are represented and quantized.

blocks.en: Most existing weight-only quantization methods operate directly in Cartesian coordinates. In this representation, a single weight outlier can expand the quantization range of the entire group, reducing the effective information density assigned to non-outlier weights. This effect is tolerable at moderate bit-widths but especially damaging at 2 or 3 bits.

blocks.en: Based on these insights, we propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. We further design an efficient codebook fine-tuning method and a hardware-friendly CUDA kernel. Specifically, direct fine-tuning of 8D unit vectors in direction codebook requires projecting updates back to the unit sphere, which can discard useful update components and reduce optimization efficiency. We therefore parameterize direction codebook entries by angles to preserve the unit-sphere constraint by construction, and densely pack extra radial bits across 8D vectors for regular CUDA loads and fused lookup, dequantization, and matrix multiplication.
blocks.zh: 基于这些洞察力,我们提出SPHQuant,一个无旋转的球面重量唯量化框架,用于VLM. 我们进一步设计了高效的代码簿微调方法和硬件友好的CUDA内核. 具体来说,方向代码簿中直接微调8D单位向量需要将更新投射回单位域,这可以丢弃有用的更新组件,降低优化效率. 因此,我们将方向代码簿条目按角度参数化,以通过构造来保持单位-层的制约,并用密集的包外光线位跨越8D向量,用于常规的CUDA载荷和熔化的仰视,脱量化,以及矩阵乘法.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , SPHQuant achieves competitive accuracy on multiple recent VLMs under extreme low-bit weight-only quantization, while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. In summary, our contributions include: • We identify a rotation-free spherical representation for extreme low-bit VLM quantization, isolating outlier magnitude in the radius while keeping directions close to uniform. • We propose SPHQuant, which decouples each 8D weight vector into radius and direction, compactly quantizes directions, and allocates extra bits to the radius for outlier robustness. • We design angle-parameterized codebook fine-tuning and a CUDA-friendly kernel with dense radial-bit packing and fused dequantization for efficient inference. • We demonstrate competitive extreme low-bit accuracy across recent VLMs and a 30.3% decoding-throughput improvement over QTIP on RTX A6000.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Modern LLM-based VLMs combine visual perception with language backbones for multimodal understanding and reasoning [ 27 , 22 ] . As VLMs evolve from adapter-based architectures toward native multimodal foundation models such as Qwen3.5 [ 21 ] , Gemma4 [ 8 ] , they enable applications including mobile assistants, OCR, document understanding, embodied agents, and real-time visual reasoning. However, their language backbones dominate parameter storage and decode-stage memory traffic, making weight-only PTQ important for deployment. Extreme 2- and 3-bit VLM quantization remains challenging because it must preserve multimodal accuracy while achieving real speedups with efficient low-bit kernels.
blocks.zh: 基于LLM的现代VLM将视觉感知与语言骨干结合,用于多式联运理解和推理[27,22]. 随着VLMs从基于适配器的架构向诸如Quen3.5[21],Gemma4[8]等本土多式联运基础模型演化,它们可以实现应用,包括移动助手,OCR,文档理解,内含代理,以及实时视觉推理. 然而,他们的语言骨干主导了参数存储和解码级内存流量,使得只重的PTQ对部署很重要. 极端的2位和3位的VLM量化仍然具有挑战性,因为它必须保持多式联运的准确性,同时以高效的低位内核实现真正的速度.

blocks.en: Weight-only PTQ reduces model memory and decode traffic without full retraining. The simplest baseline is round-to-nearest (RTN) linear quantization, which maps a weight group to b b -bit integer codes with a uniform scale and zero point: Q ⁡ ( 𝐰 ) = clip ⁡ ( ⌊ 𝐰 s ⌉ + z , 0 , 2 b − 1 ) , s = max ⁡ ( 𝐰 ) − min ⁡ ( 𝐰 ) 2 b − 1 , z = − ⌊ min ⁡ ( 𝐰 ) s ⌉ . Q(\mathbf{w})=\operatorname{clip}\left(\left\lfloor\frac{\mathbf{w}}{s}\right\rceil+z,0,2^{b}-1\right),\quad s=\frac{\max(\mathbf{w})-\min(\mathbf{w})}{2^{b}-1},\quad z=-\left\lfloor\frac{\min(\mathbf{w})}{s}\right\rceil. (2) Scalar methods such as GPTQ [ 9 ] and AWQ [ 15 ] are hardware-friendly at 4 bits, but become fragile near 2 bits due to outliers and limitation of linear quantization. Transform and vector-code methods improve ultra-low-bit accuracy: QuIP/QuIP# use incoherence processing [ 3 , 24 ] , QTIP uses trellis-coded quantization [ 25 ] , and ParoQuant reduces rotation overhead through pairwise rotations [ 14 ] . Direction–magnitude decomposition has also been explored in PVQ [ 26 ] and PCDVQ [ 33 ] . PVQ combines Hadamard coherence processing with an implicit integer-lattice representation of directions and separate gain quantization. PCDVQ uses randomized Hadamard regularization and distribution-aligned direction and magnitude codebooks. SPHQuant instead quantizes the original vectors without rotation, adapts its direction codebook through angular fine-tuning, and allocates extra precision to the radius to handle large magnitudes. Our contribution lies in this combination of representation, bit allocation, optimization, and efficient decoding rather than the direction–magnitude decomposition alone. VLM-specific methods such as MBQ [ 13 ] and VEQ [ 20 ] model modality sensitivity or expert heterogeneity, but they mainly improve calibration objectives under conventional linear quantization.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we introduce SPHQuant, a novel weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. We first describe how SPHQuant performs spherical weight quantization and fine-tunes the quantization parameters. Then, we explain how to implement an efficient CUDA kernel for SPHQuant.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍SPHQuant,一个新型的唯重量化框架,用于VLM. 我们首先描述SPHQuant如何进行球状量子化并微调量子化参数. 然后,我们解释如何为SPHQuant执行高效的CUDA内核.

blocks.en: 3.2 Outlier-Aware Radial Bit Allocation
blocks.zh: 3.2 外部- 了解辐射位分配

blocks.en: As discussed in Sec. 1 , spherical coordinates isolate the effect of weight outliers into the radius. Compared with quantizing weights in Cartesian coordinates, spherical quantization concentrates outliers in the radius only, so we can mitigate the outlier problem by allocating extra bits to the radius. To verify that the accuracy gain from increasing the radius bit-width comes from mitigating outliers rather than simply using more bits, we introduce a matched-bit control experiment on layer 0 of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 如Sec.1所述,球形坐标将重量外架的作用隔离到半径. 相比于笛卡尔座标中的量子化,球形的量子化只集中在半径外,所以我们可以通过向半径分配额外的位数来缓解量子化的问题. 为了验证增加半径比特-width的精度增益来自减轻外延,而不是仅仅使用更多的比特,我们在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct的0层上引入匹配比特控制实验.

blocks.en: From Fig. 3.2 , as the equivalent bit-width increases from 2.00 to 2.25, SPHQuant improves much faster than the random mixed-precision RTN baseline. This indicates that the gain is not merely due to using more bits, but comes from allocating the extra precision to the radial component where outlier magnitude is concentrated. We further discuss how allocating extra bits to the radius or direction affects final accuracy in Sec. 4.3 .

blocks.en: After the spherical quantization step, the trainable parameters are the continuous radius parameters 𝝆 \boldsymbol{\rho} and the direction codebook parameters ϕ \boldsymbol{\phi} . The codebook is initialized by radius-weighted spherical k-means, while the pre-quantization radii are initialized by projection onto the assigned directions.

3.4 Efficient Kernel Implementation
blocks.zh: 3.4 高效核心执行

blocks.en: We implement efficient dequantization in a fused CUDA GEMV kernel [ 19 ] . The following packed layout and 64-entry codebook apply to W2 with B = 2 B=2 and V = 4 V=4 .
blocks.zh: 我们实施高效的离子化 在一个熔化的CUDA GEMV内核 [19]. 以下包装布局和64进制编码本适用于W2,其中B=2 B=2,V=4 V=4.

blocks.en: Packed extra radius bits. Along the input dimension, every 128 weights form one quantization group, corresponding to 16 8D weight vectors. For each 8D vector, SPHQuant stores its packed quantized code in one 16-bit word: the lower 8 bits encode signs, the next 6 bits encode the direction codebook index, and the upper 2 bits encode the low bits of the radius code. Since the radius receives extra precision, each 128-weight group additionally stores one 32-bit word that packs the extra 2 radius bits of all 16 vectors. This word-aligned layout enables coalesced global-memory access.
blocks.zh: 外加半径位数 沿着输入维度,每128个重量组成一个量子组,对应16个8D重量矢量. 对于每个8D向量,SPHQuant将其包装的四位数编码存储在一个16位词中:下8位编码符号,下6位编码方向代码索引,上2位编码半径代码的低位. 由于半径得到额外的精度,每个128重量组额外存储一个32位单词,将所有16个向量中额外的2个半径位进行包装. 此单词对齐的布局可以连接到全局- memory 访问.

blocks.en: Shared-memory direction lookup. We preload the 64-entry direction codebook into shared memory and store each 8D direction as four half2 pairs. During GEMV, each lane loads the direction by codebook index, restores coordinate signs from the packed sign bits, and multiplies the signed direction by the dequantized radius.
blocks.zh: 共享记忆方向查询. 我们预装64进取方向代码簿到共享内存中,并将每个8D方向存储为四个半对. 在GEMV期间,每个车道通过编码本索引加载方向,从打包的标志位恢复坐标标志,并用解码半径乘以签名方向.

blocks.en: Fused dequantization and accumulation. For each 8D vector, SPHQuant reconstructs the weight block only in registers. The reconstructed block is immediately multiplied with the fp16 activation values and accumulated in fp32. By fusing radius dequantization, direction lookup, sign restoration, and GEMV accumulation in one kernel, SPHQuant avoids writing dequantized weights to global memory while preserving the accuracy benefit of extra radial precision.
blocks.zh: 腐烂的腐烂和积累。 对于每个8D向量,SPHQuant只在登记簿中重建重量块. 重建的块立即与fp16激活值乘以fp32累积. 通过一个内核的引信半径分解,方向检查,符号恢复,以及GEMV积累,SPHQuant避免将分解的权重写入全球内存,同时保留超射线精度的精度收益.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Models and Tasks. We evaluate SPHQuant on recent VLMs covering different model scales and architectures: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] , Qwen3.5-9B [ 21 ] , and Gemma4-26B-A4B-it [ 10 ] . For standard multimodal evaluation, we use benchmarks covering college-level multimodal understanding: MMMU_val [ 31 ] ; scene text understanding: TextVQA [ 23 ] ; science question answering: ScienceQA [ 17 ] ; real-world visual understanding: RealWorldQA [ 30 ] ; and general multimodal perception: MMStar [ 4 ] . For reasoning-oriented evaluation, we enable the thinking mode of Qwen3.5-9B on MMMU-Pro [ 32 ] to assess long-form multimodal reasoning accuracy.
blocks.zh: 模型与任务. 我们根据最近涉及不同模型尺度和结构的虚拟LM评价SPHQuant: Quen3-VL-8B-指示[1],Quen3.5-9B [21],和Gemma4-26B-A4B-it [10]. 在标准多式联运评价方面,我们使用涵盖大学一级多式联运理解的基准:MMMU_val[31];场景文本理解:TextVQA[23];科学问题回答:ScienceQA[17];现实世界视觉理解:RealWorldQA[30];以及一般多式联运感: MMStar [4] (英语). 对于以推理为导向的评价,我们使得MMMU-Pro上的Quen3.5-9B的思维模式[32]能够评估长式多式联运推理的准确性.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare SPHQuant with two categories of weight-only PTQ baselines. Linear quantization methods: AWQ [ 15 ] , MBQ [ 13 ] , and ParoQuant [ 14 ] . AWQ uses activation-aware scaling to protect salient weights, MBQ improves VLM quantization with modality-balanced calibration, and ParoQuant applies pairwise rotations to reduce rotation overhead. Vector quantization methods: QTIP [ 25 ] , which uses trellis-coded quantization with incoherence processing to improve extreme low-bit accuracy. Since the novel architecture of Gemma4-26B-A4B depends on a specialized training procedure, we do not include ParoQuant or QTIP results on this model.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较SPHQuant和两类只重的PTQ基线. 线性量化方法: AWQ [15], MBQ [13], 和 ParoQuant [14]. AWQ使用激活-意识缩放来保护显著的重量,MBQ通过方式平衡校准来改进VLM的量化,ParoQuant采用双向旋转来减少旋转的俯仰. 矢量量化方法:QTIP [25],使用triellis-coded quantization与不一致处理,以提高极低位精度. 由于Gemma4-26B-A4B的新建筑依赖于专门的训练程序,所以我们不包括ParoQuant或QTIP在这个模型上的结果.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. We use 2048 COCO samples [ 16 ] for calibration and reserve 128 samples for validation. Quantization is performed with a group size of 128. The direction codebook is initialized by spherical k-means with 65,536 sampled vectors and 20 iterations. We optimize the spherical quantization parameters with layer-wise reconstruction using MSE loss, where the student layer takes activations from the quantized stream. Joint optimization is run for 20 epochs with Adam [ 12 ] , using learning rates of 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} for both radius parameters and codebook parameters. We select the best checkpoint according to validation loss. Layer-wise calibration is conducted on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU with 96GB memory. For W2 evaluations, we use V = 4 V=4 radius bits, yielding 2.25 encoded bits per weight; the Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct W3 results in Tab. 1 use 3.125. Both payloads exclude group-wise parameters and direction codebooks; Sec. 7 details the storage accounting. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, calibration also preserves DeepStack visual features to match the real multimodal inference path; details are provided in Sec. 8 .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose SPHQuant, a spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. By representing weights in spherical coordinates, SPHQuant decouples outlier magnitudes from bounded directional information and enables more effective bit allocation under extreme low-bit constraints. We further develop efficient optimization and hardware-friendly inference support to preserve accuracy while reducing runtime overhead. Experiments on recent VLMs show that SPHQuant achieves competitive extreme low-bit accuracy and improves decoding throughput by 30.3% over QTIP on RTX A6000. SPHQuant combines outlier handling, codebook design, and kernel efficiency through a spherical representation for practical extreme low-bit VLM deployment.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出SPHQuant,一个球形的唯重量化框架,用于VLM. 通过在球面坐标中表示权重,SPHQuant将离线量级与定界方向信息脱钩,并在极低位限制下实现更有效的位分配. 我们进一步发展高效优化和硬件友好推论支持,以保持准确性,同时减少运行时间间接费用。 对近期VLM的实验表明,SPHQuant公司在RTX A6000上实现了竞争性的极低位精度,并将编码吞吐量比QTIP提高了30.3%. SPHQuant通过球面代表将外部处理,代码本设计,内核效率结合起来,用于实用的极低位VLM部署.

blocks.en: 7 Additional Experiment Settings
blocks.zh: 7 额外实验设置

blocks.en: SPHQuant assigns two extra radial bits to each 8D vector in the W2 setting, resulting in an encoded weight payload of 2.25 bits per weight, excluding group-wise quantization parameters and codebook storage. This extra budget is used only for the radius, as motivated by Sec. 3.2 , where outlier magnitude is concentrated. Although this gives SPHQuant 0.25 more bits than strict 2-bit methods, the comparison should be interpreted with this storage difference in mind. Additional bits increase memory traffic, while Tab. 3 shows that SPHQuant is still faster than QTIP and ParoQuant. This is enabled by the compact positive-direction codebook and packed radial-bit layout described in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: SPHQuant在W2设置中为每个8D向量分配两个额外的射线比特,导致每重量2.25比特的编码重量有效载荷,不包括分组定量参数和编码本存储. 这种额外预算只用于半径,这是由3.2.Sec.所激发的,其超度集中。 虽然这使得SPHQuant 0.25比严格的2位方法多出比特,但比较应该根据这种存储差异来解释. 附加的比特增加了内存流量,而Tab. 3显示SPHQuant仍然比QTIP和ParoQuant快. 这是通过Sec.3.4中描述的紧凑正向编码本和包装的射线位布局实现的。

blocks.en: The original throughput experiment uses RTX A6000. The additional evaluation uses RTX 4090 with 24 GB of memory, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, batch size 1, 256 prefill tokens, and 512 generated tokens. Tab. 10 reports the additional throughput results, and Tab. 11 reports measured GPU-memory consumption. These quantities are presented separately from encoded bits per weight because they capture different aspects of deployment cost.
blocks.zh: 最初的吞吐量实验使用RTX A6000. 附加评价采用RTX 4090,内存为24GB,Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct,批量尺寸1,256个预填符,512个生成符. Tab.10报告了额外的吞吐量结果,Tab.11报告测量了GPU-分子消耗量。 这些数量与每个重量的编码比特分开列报,因为它们包含部署成本的不同方面。

blocks.en: The additional comparison in Tab. 12 evaluates RTN, ParoQuant, and SPHQuant at 3.00 and 3.125 encoded bits per weight on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. For SPHQuant with 8D vectors, the encoded payload is ( 7 ​ B + V ) / 8 (7B+V)/8 bits per weight; it excludes group-wise quantization parameters and direction codebooks. The SPHQuant W3 row for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct in Tab. 1 corresponds to the 3.125-bit result. Keeping these payloads explicit avoids interpreting nominal W2/W3 labels as complete model-storage measurements.
blocks.zh: Tab. 12中的额外比较评价了RTN,ParoQuant和SPHQuant在Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct上每个重量的编码位数为3.00和3.125. 对于拥有8D向量的SPHQuant,编码有效载荷为(7 B + V ) / 8(7 B+V)/8位/重量;它排除了组位量化参数和方向编码本. SPHQuant W3列,用于Tab中的Quen3-VL-8B-指令. 1对应3.125位结果. 保持这些有效载荷的明确性可避免将标称的W2/W3标签解释为完整的模型存储测量。

blocks.en: For fair comparison, we keep the optimization budget of QTIP, ParoQuant, and SPHQuant in a similar single-GPU range. Since the three methods use different optimization procedures, e.g., QTIP optimizes linear layers individually, ParoQuant [ 14 ] uses a two-stage optimization pipeline, and SPHQuant performs layer-wise spherical reconstruction, we match their practical quantization cost rather than forcing identical hyperparameters. Tab. 8 reports the training samples, epochs, wall-clock time, and device used for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平的比较,我们将QTIP,ParoQuant和SPHQuant的优化预算保持在类似的单GPU范围. 由于三种方法使用不同的优化程序,例如QTIP单独优化线性层,ParoQuant [14]使用两阶段优化管道,SPHQuant进行层层重建,所以我们与其实际的量化成本相匹配,而不是强迫相同的超参数. Tab. 8报告了训练样品、时间、时间和用于Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct的设备。

blocks.en: 8 DeepStack-Aware Calibration for Qwen3-VL
blocks.zh: 8 Quen3-VL 的深层软件校准

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] uses DeepStack features to inject visual information into selected language decoder layers. During calibration, SPHQuant explicitly preserves this multimodal path. The calibration inputs are first preprocessed by process_model , and the decoder layers that should receive DeepStack features are recorded through _mbq_calib_deepstack_layers . This carries visual DeepStack features with each calibration batch to the corresponding decoder layers.
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct [1] 使用DeepStack特性将视觉信息注入选定的语言解码层. 在校准过程中,SPHQuant明确保留了这种多式联运路径. 校准输入首先通过进程_模型进行预处理,应当接收DeepStack特性的解码层通过_mbq_calib_deepstack_layers录制. 这携带了视觉的DeepStack特性,每个校准批次到相应的解码层.

blocks.en: When SPHQuant captures the first-layer hidden states and the layer-wise keyword arguments, it also stores these DeepStack-related intermediate features as part of the layer input context. Therefore, during layer-wise reconstruction, each quantized layer receives the same type of multimodal context as in the original forward pass. This avoids text-only hidden-state approximation and aligns calibration with the actual vision-language inference path.
blocks.zh: 当SPHQuant捕捉到第一层隐藏状态和图层关键字参数时,它也会将这些DeepStack相关的中间特性作为图层输入上下文的一部分存储. 因此,在分层重建中,每个四分层得到的多式联运背景与原来的前传相同。 这避免了仅文本的隐藏状态近似,并与实际的视觉语言推断路径校正.

blocks.en: 9 Additional CUDA Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 9 其他CUDA执行细节

blocks.en: The following details describe the fused GEMV implementation for the W2 configuration with 8D vectors, a 64-entry positive-direction codebook, and four radius bits. They supplement the packed-weight layout in Sec. 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 以下详细介绍W2配置的已引信的GEMV执行,带有8D矢量,64进正向编码本,以及4个半径位. 它们补充了3.4塞克的包装重量布局.

blocks.en: Each thread block contains 256 threads and computes eight output channels. Each thread processes 32 FP16 activations, corresponding to four 8D weight vectors. This mapping exposes parallelism across output channels and input-vector groups while allowing the packed codes and activations to be consumed within the same kernel.
blocks.zh: 每个线程块包含256个线程,并计算出8个输出通道. 每个线程处理32 FP16激活,对应四个8D重量向量. 这种映射暴露了输出通道和输入向量组的平行性,同时允许在同一个内核内消耗包装的代码和激活.

blocks.en: The 64 × 8 64\times 8 FP16 direction codebook occupies 1 KiB and is staged in shared memory. A transposed layout arranges codebook coordinates for lookup by the decoding threads and reduces access conflicts. Direction indices select the positive unit vectors, and the separately stored sign bits restore coordinate signs during reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 64×8 64\times 8 FP16方向代码册占据1KiB,在共享内存中上演. 移植版式安排代码簿坐标,由解码线程进行查找,减少访问冲突. 方向指数选择正单位向量,单独存储的符号比特在重建过程中恢复坐标标志.

blocks.en: Bit operations extract the coordinate signs, six-bit direction index, and low radius bits from each 16-bit base word. The additional 32-bit word for a group supplies the extra radius bits of its 16 vectors. After assembling the radius code, a fused multiply-add applies the group’s scale and offset to reconstruct the radius. Direction lookup, sign restoration, radius reconstruction, and multiplication with the activations are fused, avoiding a global-memory buffer of dequantized weights.
blocks.zh: 比特操作从每个16位基词中提取坐标标志,6位方向指数,以及低半径位. 一个组的额外32位字提供了其16个矢量的额外半径位. 组合半径代码后,一个被引信加成的乘法应用组的尺度并抵消来重建半径. 方向检查,标志恢复,半径重建,与激活的乘法结合,避免了全球积分减重缓冲.

blocks.en: The kernel uses vectorized half2 instructions for pairwise operations on FP16 values and accumulates partial results in FP32. Warp-shuffle operations and shared-memory reductions combine thread-local contributions into the output channels. The CUDA kernel will be released with the implementation.
blocks.zh: 内核在FP16值上采用矢量半2指令进行对偶操作,并在FP32中积累部分结果. Wrp-shuffle操作和共享记忆的削减将线程-局部贡献结合到输出通道中. CUDA内核随执行而发布.

blocks.zh: 10 补充比较和部署试验

blocks.en: 10.1 Comparison with Direction–Magnitude Quantization
blocks.zh: 10.1 与方向定量比较

blocks.en: PVQ [ 26 ] and PCDVQ [ 33 ] provide closely related approaches that separately represent weight direction and magnitude. Tab. 9 compares their evaluated implementations with SPHQuant on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. SPHQuant improves MMMU accuracy by 2.0 and 2.4 percentage points over PVQ and PCDVQ, respectively, and TextVQA by 3.1 and 2.6 percentage points. It also achieves higher measured decoding throughput in this comparison. Together, these results support the practical effectiveness of SPHQuant’s combination of rotation-free quantization, adaptive angular codebooks, and radial bit allocation; they do not isolate the contribution of any one component.
blocks.zh: PVQ[26]和PCDVQ[33]提供了密切相关的方法,分别代表重量方向和数量。 标签9将其评价的实施与Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct上的SPHQuant进行比较。 SPHQuant将MMU的精度分别比PVQ和PCDVQ提高2.0和2.4个百分点,TextVQA提高3.1和2.6个百分点. 在这个比较中,它也实现了更高的测量解码吞吐量. 这些结果共同支持SPHQuant将无旋转量子化、适应性角码本和射线位分配结合起来的实际效果;它们并不孤立任何部分的贡献。

blocks.en: 11 Limitations
blocks.zh: 11 限制

blocks.en: SPHQuant is designed for efficient extreme low-bit weight-only quantization of VLMs, but several limitations remain. First, our throughput evaluation covers RTX A6000 and RTX 4090, but does not establish performance on embedded or mobile-class devices. The added RTX 4090 evaluation uses batch size 1 and a fixed sequence-length configuration; broader batch-size and context-length studies remain necessary. Since the practical benefit of low-bit inference depends on memory hierarchy, shared-memory capacity, instruction scheduling, and kernel integration, the efficiency of SPHQuant should be further validated on a wider range of devices. The additional radius storage can also affect whether a model fits when memory capacity is close to its footprint. Second, although we evaluate representative multimodal benchmarks, VLMs are often deployed in diverse real-world applications such as mobile OCR, document understanding, visual assistance, and embodied reasoning. More task-specific evaluations under realistic latency, input-resolution, and generation-length constraints are needed to fully characterize the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in deployment.
blocks.zh: SPHQuant是为VLM高效的极低位重量只量化而设计的,但仍有一些限制. 一,我们的吞吐量评价涵盖RTX A6000和RTX 4090,但没有在嵌入式或移动级设备上建立性能. 新增的RTX 4090评价采用批号尺寸1和固定序列长度配置;仍有必要进行更广泛的批号尺寸和上下文长度研究。 由于低位推论的实际好处取决于内存等级,共享记忆容量,指令调度,以及内核集成,所以SPHQuant的效率应该在更广泛的设备上进一步验证. 额外的半径存储也会影响一个模型在内存容量接近其足迹时是否适合. 第二,虽然我们评价具有代表性的多式联运基准, VLM常常被部署在各种现实世界的应用中,例如移动式OCR,文件理解,视觉协助,以及体现的推理. 需要在现实的延迟性、输入分辨率和生成时间的限制下进行更多的具体任务评价,以充分说明部署中的准确效率权衡的特点。

blocks.en: 12 Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: 12 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: By reducing the memory footprint and improving decoding throughput of VLMs, SPHQuant may help make multimodal models more accessible on resource-constrained devices. This can support privacy-preserving on-device inference, reduce dependence on cloud connectivity, and lower the energy and hardware cost of deploying useful visual-language applications.
blocks.zh: 通过减少记忆足迹和改善VLM的解码吞吐量,SPHQuant可能有助于使多种模式更容易在资源约束的设备上访问. 这可以支持对设备的保密推断,减少对云连接的依赖,降低部署有用的视觉语言应用程序的能量和硬件成本.
